_about: Articles to turn into shorts, in order. When the list is used up, the newest guides without a short follow. Oct 2026: nationwide, seasonal 'Korea in <month>' and whole-trip itineraries do best (Korea in December 431 views, Korea 7 Day 281), so those come first. 26 Oct: month names beat season names (Korea in December 444 views, November 226, but 'Korea Autumn Leaves' 11), so month pages come before season pages and seasonal shorts are titled by month. 21 Nov: the entry-requirements Reel reached 1,000 views in a day (others 70-120), so 'before you fly' practical topics (transit card, airport to Seoul, money, arrival checklist, maps, payments, apps, KTX) come next. 28 Nov: review of 26 Shorts (content/youtube_stats.json): month and season topics lead (median 85 views, 55% watched), itineraries next (56, 46%), 'before you fly' practical topics last (46, 31%; the four made since 21 Nov got 30-40 views), and nearly half of all views come from YouTube search. So the practical topics move to the end; timely month and season pages (New Year sunrise, Busan in winter, March, cherry blossom, April, best time to visit) alternate with mistake, food and money topics (travel mistakes, street food, ordering food, budget, dining etiquette), then the last itineraries.
